name: BSP_AiGroup_SetCommand
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Body read in full (00a2bd00-00a2bd30), __thiscall(ECX = AI group)(command), RET 4. Deletes the previous command at group+564ch through its vtable slot 0 with the flag 1, then stores the new pointer; the null path stores without deleting. Passing the pointer the group already holds would free it and leave it dangling. Sole call site 00a37ade, the AISetCommand Lua binding. docs/LUA_BINDING_AI.md.

name: BSP_AiGroup_ForwardCommand
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(aiGroup /*ECX*/, void* command, const SceneCommandTarget* target). Seven instructions: reads aiGroup+564Ch (the group's current command object, docs/LUA_BINDING_AI.md kAiGroupCommandOffset) and tail-jumps to its vtable[24h] with both stack arguments, or RET 8 when it is null. Ghidra's unrecovered-jumptable warning at 00a2bd9f is that tail call. Callers 0077d600 and 0071ecf0. Complete: 00a2bd90-00a2bda3. docs/ENTITY_ORDER_MESSAGE.md

name: BSP_AiGroup_AddEntity
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Head read (00a2d8e0-00a2d9cb; first 14 instructions read, tail not read): __thiscall(ECX = AI group)(entity). Calls 009fe0b0 on the entity, stores the group into entity+16ch at 00a2d8f5 and links the entity into the group's list at group+10h. Call site 00a38cf6, the AICreateGroup loop, for every entity after the first. docs/LUA_BINDING_AI.md.

name: BSP_AiGroup_RemoveEntity
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Head read (00a2d9d0-00a2da53; first 14 instructions read, tail not read): __thiscall(ECX = AI group)(entity, 1). Passes the entity's address to 0077bea0 against the list at group+563ch, then clears entity+16ch when it still points at this group. Call site 00a38ca5, the AICreateGroup loop, for an entity that already had a group. docs/LUA_BINDING_AI.md.
